in_sanskrit.name: अस्मि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The root 'as' means 'I' and 'mi' means 'am'. Therefore, the name Asmi means 'I am'.

in_hindi.name: अस्मी
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Asmī is derived from Sanskrit अस्मि. The meaning of 'Asmī' is 'I am' in Hindi, and it is pronounced as 'ahs-me-ee'.

in_tamil.name: அஸ்மி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Asmi is derived from Sanskrit अस्मि. The meaning of 'Asmi' in Tamil is 'I am' or 'I exist', and it is pronounced as 'ahs-me-ee'.

in_telugu.name: ఆశ్మీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name आश्मी is derived from Sanskrit अस्मि. The meaning of 'आश्मी' in Telugu is 'I am' or 'I exist', and it is pronounced as 'ahs-me-ee'.

in_marathi.name: Asmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Self, I, Mine
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘as’ meaning ‘self’, ‘I’, ‘mine’. This name signifies a deep sense of self-awareness and individuality. In Hindu mythology, it is also the name of a goddess, Asami, associated with the sun, light, and knowledge.
